sections.text_helper: Section 33.4.7 "TIM prescaler (TIM_PSC)" in chapter 33 (Basic timers (TIM6/TIM7)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1278.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x28
Reset value: 0x0000
Bits 15:0 PSC[15:0]: Prescaler value
The counter clock frequency ftim_cnt_ck is equal to ftim_psc_ck / (PSC[15:0] + 1).
PSC contains the value to be loaded into the active prescaler register at each update event.
(including when the counter is cleared through UG bit of TIM_EGR register.
